hardware.variant: One provisioned ESP-Mosaico V1.2 kit with an existing SSH host key.

inputs.name: R4 network-appliance LittleFS image
inputs.revision: R4 provisioned network-appliance profile, 10 MiB LittleFS at NOR offset 0x600000; native writer hash verification passed.

inputs.name: R3 misplaced-keyword startup attempt
inputs.revision: network-appliance KEYWORD outside the initial rcorder metadata block

scenario: Boot the R4 root from NOR using POWER, measure rc, and sign in by its mDNS hostname using the pinned SSH host key.
expected: The 13 selected startup scripts run in dependency order. The board associates with WPA3/PMF, obtains IPv4 and accepts SSH by name.
observed: The operator saw the EmberBSD logo and startup messages. Cold NOR boot reached login. The rc log spanned 189 seconds (12:00:08 to 12:03:17). Host-monotonic UART timing from SPI_FAST_FLASH_BOOT was 194.730 seconds to Starting sshd and 219.802 seconds to the login prompt. The station reported COMPLETED, SAE, CCMP and pmf=1; espwifi0 had IPv4 and pinned SSH by mDNS name succeeded. The initial contiguous rcorder directive block in each selected script contains the network-appliance keyword. The unpacked R4 root retained its provisioned keys and network profiles. It has 1788 KiB available, compared with 704 KiB in the baseline image. The earlier live filesystem measurement before restart increased from 171 to 424 blocks of 4096 bytes after removing the standalone ssh-keygen.

measurements.name: ordinary-cold-power-rc-baseline
measurements.unit: seconds; rc exit status 0, from separate baseline observation

limits: Single cold POWER run on one kit. The rc timestamps measure elapsed time; its wall clock was unset. The rc exit code was not captured for R4.
The live-root and unpacked-image free-space measurements cover different filesystem states.
The DHCP daemon started and the interface had IPv4. Lease acquisition timing was not measured.
